method: Derived from frozen P2 artifacts only. No new model runs, no download, zero cost.

r2.verdict: FAIL — the ensemble CANNOT clear the R2 bar. The union of what both models close is 3/20, below the frozen bar of 4. This is an upper bound assuming a perfect per-case selector, so no selector quality can close the wall.
r2.implication: The R2 gap is not a selection problem; it is a capability problem. The two models fail the SAME 17 cases. Complementarity exists but is confined to 3 cases and does not reach the bar.

t4.verdict: FAIL as a two-model ensemble. Two models cannot form a majority; the guaranteed consensus floor is 30%, far below the 90% bar. Reaching the bar would require a third vote or a tiebreak that outperforms the stronger single model on 65% of samples — an unmeasured assumption, not a result.
t4.implication: T4 is not an ensemble problem either at this model scale.
